title: Tim Taylor's background as NASA mission controller

tellings.quote: He's a mysterious rocket scientist who's done mission control for NASA since the8s.

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor has worked mission control for NASA rocket launches since the 1980s, according to Michels, who calls him "a mysterious rocket scientist" and credits a source called Launch Fever. Michels brings this up while presenting Taylor as someone NASA studies because UFOs are said to appear around him, so his long space career is offered as a reason to take him seriously.
